meta.name: pathfinder
meta.description: Map a codebase into feature-grouped flowcharts, identify duplicated concerns across features, and propose a unified architecture. Use when asked to "find the ideal path," unify duplicated systems, or audit architecture before a refactor. Emits a proposed unified flowchart plus per-system /make-plan prompts.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将代码库映射为功能流程图，识别重复并统一架构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在重构或统一多个重复系统
copy.tagline_en: Map codebase into feature flowcharts, identify duplicates, and unify architecture
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are refactoring or unifying duplicated systems

howto.what: 安装后，Claude会把你代码库拆成功能模块，逐个画出流程图，找出不同功能里重复的代码逻辑，给出简化后的统一架构，并生成含文件定位的报告和可直接复制的改造提示。
howto.when: 当你要求“找出理想路径”、统一重复系统，或在重构前审查架构时触发。

say.text: 请找出这个项目里跨功能重复的代码并统一它们。
say.note: Claude会执行重复检测并给出统一方案。

say.text: 在重构前帮我审计一遍整体架构。
say.note: 触发Pathfinder完整流程，先画现状流程图。

say.text: 为这个代码库找到最理想的路径并画出流程图。
say.note: Claude会按功能分组建图并标注文件位置。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude maps the codebase into feature-grouped flowcharts, detects duplicated concerns across features, proposes a simplified unified architecture, and produces reports plus per-system /make-plan prompts.
howto.when_en: It triggers when asked to "find the ideal path," unify duplicated systems, or audit architecture before a refactor.

say_en.text: Find duplicated code across features in this project and unify it.
say_en.note: Runs duplication detection and unification proposal.

say_en.text: Audit the overall architecture before my refactor.
say_en.note: Triggers the full Pathfinder flow starting with feature discovery.

say_en.text: Find the ideal path for this codebase and draw the flowcharts.
say_en.note: Maps features and labels nodes with file:line.
